; Draw pixel (12, 9), then echo keyboard input.
LDI 12
STA 0xF4
LDI 9
STA 0xF5
LDI 1
STA 0xF6
; Echo UTF-8 bytes through the memory-mapped keyboard and terminal.
wait:
LDA 0xF0
JZ wait
LDA 0xF1
STA 0xF2
JMP wait
